claim: TraceSOC finalist technical candidate is frozen at commit 8751a679f36b4983cdd3d2b0b35f44e9a11c4f39 and tree fc420ee3fd1988cf578c0cf309ee3aefcccf33b2.
proves: Identifies the exact pre-holdout technical candidate.
does_not_prove: Does not by itself prove unseen-evidence generalization or detection accuracy.
alternative_considered: A later packaging commit may exist, but the technical candidate remains this freeze.

claim: The frozen candidate currently passes 524/524 regression tests and all 4 public acceptance classes.
proves: The frozen candidate passes the current machine-readable regression surface.
does_not_prove: Regression success does not establish universal correctness or detector accuracy.
alternative_considered: External and post-freeze evidence validation is independently required.

claim: The six-source R3 case contains 5,442 canonical observations, 32,658 detection evaluations, 5 matched detections and 6 findings.
proves: Demonstrates integrated processing of the controlled six-source reference case.
does_not_prove: Does not establish that the controlled reference activity is malicious ground truth.
alternative_considered: The same evidence is correctly interpreted as controlled interoperability/provenance validation.

claim: All 5,442 R3 canonical observations carry raw locators.
proves: Every R3 canonical observation is anchored to raw location metadata.
does_not_prove: Locator presence alone does not establish the correctness of every interpretation.
alternative_considered: End-to-end downstream linkage is tested separately.

claim: A complete R3 chain was mechanically proved from response to original raw artifact SHA-256.
proves: Demonstrates mechanical reversibility of one complete downstream analytical chain.
does_not_prove: Does not establish maliciousness, causality, incident membership or executed response.
alternative_considered: The selected chain is evidence-backed corroboration rather than a compromise verdict.

claim: External IoT-23 Zeek evidence reconciled 23,145 source rows to 23,145 canonical observations without using publisher labels as expected verdicts.
proves: Supports real external Zeek representation ingestion/accounting beyond the controlled case.
does_not_prove: Matched detections are not claimed as ground-truth maliciousness or accuracy.
alternative_considered: Representation generalization and detector accuracy are separate questions.

claim: The sealed semantically unseen holdout reconciled 156,458 source rows to 156,458 canonical observations and executed 938,748 detector evaluations after freeze.
proves: Supports post-freeze ingestion, provenance, accounting and representation generalization.
does_not_prove: Zero matched detections do not establish true/false-negative rates or accuracy.
alternative_considered: Detection accuracy remains UNADJUDICATED because no exact valid scoring comparator was established.

claim: All 9,672 reference PCAPNG packet locators are accounted: 5,412 normalized IPv4 TCP/UDP events plus 4,260 processing issues, with zero recorded errors.
proves: The 4,260 issue records are mechanically reconciled under supported-partial PCAP handling.
does_not_prove: Does not establish protocol names for the two non-IPv4 EtherType values or universal PCAP support.
alternative_considered: Raw frames remain preserved even when not normalized into the supported IPv4 model.

claim: Two fresh frozen six-source reproductions completed in 3.438 s and 3.393 s and produced the same 11 deterministic core artifact hashes as each other and as R3.
proves: Demonstrates deterministic regeneration of the measured R3 analytical outputs.
does_not_prove: The ~4.5 MiB child-process metric is not total system consumption or a universal scalability bound.
alternative_considered: A separate scale benchmark provides the stronger resource measurement.

claim: The real-format scale benchmark processed 198,463 records with 198,463 accepted, zero quarantined and 198,463 semantic events in 15.9617856 seconds; peak working set was 486,924,288 bytes.
proves: Demonstrates measured parser/accounting/semantic-conversion resource behavior on the target workstation.
does_not_prove: Real cross-source correlation was not executed in this benchmark and detector accuracy is not measured.
alternative_considered: Runtime is descriptive because no runtime threshold was frozen.

claim: The closure audit found zero selected known reference-answer literal hits in frozen production source.
proves: Supports the measured anti-hardcoding control against selected known literals.
does_not_prove: A finite literal scan cannot prove absence of every possible hardcoding mechanism.
alternative_considered: External and post-freeze behavior provides additional generalization evidence.

claim: The final carry-forward audit records 13 transferable lessons SATISFIED, 4 historical task-specific requirements NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_TRACESOC and 0 OPEN.
proves: Shows explicit reconciliation of applicable prior grader engineering lessons.
does_not_prove: Does not predict or guarantee an external competition result.
alternative_considered: Historical task-specific answers are not silently reintroduced as TraceSOC requirements.

claim: detection_result_id is not globally unique across distinct no-match evaluations; hypothesis-cited matched IDs measured in R3 are unique.
proves: Defines the measured identifier limitation and its effect on R3 reverse traceability.
does_not_prove: Does not establish globally unique identity for all no-match detection evaluations.
alternative_considered: Future product work can strengthen no-match result identity semantics.

claim: Post-freeze holdout detection accuracy remains UNADJUDICATED.
proves: Prevents zero matched detections from being converted into an unsupported accuracy claim.
does_not_prove: Does not establish precision, recall, FPR, FNR, TPR or TNR.
alternative_considered: An exact observation-level labeled comparator would be required for scoring.

claim: Cross-publisher network holdout diversity is not established because development and holdout network evidence both originate from IoT-23.
proves: Defines the current population boundary of network generalization evidence.
does_not_prove: Does not support a cross-publisher network generalization claim.
alternative_considered: A future sealed corpus from another publisher would address this limitation.

claim: No controlled reference observable is promoted to a confirmed malicious IOC.
proves: Preserves the non-fabrication and non-maliciousness claim boundary.
does_not_prove: An empty confirmed-malicious IOC set does not mean observables cannot be preserved or used as validation pivots.
alternative_considered: Controlled observables remain evidence without being classified as malicious IOCs.
